Inside Information: Faron announces encouraging first overall survival data from frontline higher-risk (HR) MDS patients in the BEXMAB phase 1/2 trial
brief: Faron reports encouraging OS data from BEXMAB trial of bexmarilimab in higher-risk MDS patients, with median OS not yet reached in key subgroups.
summary: Faron announced first overall survival data from its BEXMAB phase 1/2 trial at median 14.9-month follow-up. In 21 treatment-naïve HR-MDS patients, median OS was not reached for TP53 wildtype and monoallelic mutated patients. Biallelic TP53 mutated patients (67% of TP53-mutated cohort) achieved median OS of 8.8 months, in line with historical data. Data supports progression toward BEXERA, a planned randomized study of bexmarilimab plus azacitidine in frontline HR-MDS.
retail_take: Early survival data showing non-inferiority in aggressive biallelic cohort and ongoing survival in other groups supports clinical development; detailed dataset awaited at scientific meeting later in 2026.

headline: NBPE Announces Transaction in Own Shares
brief: NBPE completes 30,000 Class A share buyback at £14.46-£14.64, reducing outstanding shares to 40.4m.
summary: Neuberger Private Equity Partners Limited repurchased 30,000 Class A Shares on 24 July 2026 via Jefferies International at prices between £14.46 and £14.64 per share. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Following cancellation, outstanding Class A Shares total 40,429,301, with an additional 3,150,408 held in treasury. The buyback was conducted under shareholder authority granted on 11 June 2026.
retail_take: Routine capital management action; share cancellation reduces share count, potentially supporting per-share metrics, though immaterial scale suggests this is incremental shareholder return activity rather than transformational.

headline: OSB GROUP PLC - Transaction in Own Shares
brief: OSB Group completed buyback of 14,243 shares at average 556p; shares to be cancelled.
summary: Between 20–24 July 2026, OSB Group repurchased 14,243 ordinary shares at volume-weighted average prices ranging from 553.64p to 560.95p across London Stock Exchange and alternative venues via Jefferies. Shares purchased across LSE, CBOE BXE, CBOE CXE, and Aquis Exchange. Following cancellation, issued share count falls to 341,550,929; no treasury shares held. Programme commenced 5 March 2026.
retail_take: Routine execution of disclosed buyback programme; capital returns via share cancellation reduce share count but signal no immediate growth catalyst or cash deployment concern.

headline: Transaction in Own Shares
brief: PSH repurchases 33,333 shares at average $49.76; holds 37.3m treasury shares.
summary: Pershing Square Holdings purchased 33,333 public shares on 24 July 2026 at an average price of $49.76 USD through Jefferies. The breakdown shows 22,765 shares traded on LSE (PSH ticker) averaging 3,729 pence ($49.75) and 10,568 shares on the dollar listing (PSHD) averaging $49.77. The NAV per share was $76.01 as of 21 July. Post-buyback, PSH has 173.6m shares outstanding with 37.3m shares held in treasury.
retail_take: Routine share buyback below NAV signals capital management but modest scale; non-event for most retail investors tracking the fund's NAV accretion and treasury building strategy.
